goal: Rotate the deploy key and restart the workers
why_human: The rotation invalidates running sessions, so a person decides when it happens.

app.description: Open the secrets page of {{app}} and delete DEPLOY_KEY.

steps.text: Open the secrets page of {{app}} and delete DEPLOY_KEY.

annotations.text: Should I delete the staging key as well?
The workers still answered with the old key fingerprint.

steps.text: Restart every machine from the machines page, one at a time.
steps.warning: Restarting drops in-flight jobs; do it outside business hours.

annotations.text: A restart is required for the new key to load.
The second machine took about a minute to come back.

verify: Call GET /healthz on every machine and check that all report the new key fingerprint.
